annotations.title: Estimated match: which program types fit

description: Lane PC (investor property) or BC (business capital). Returns program TYPES with plain descriptions and typical ranges from categorical answers plus optional rounded figures. An estimated match, never an offer. PC answers: deal (purchase|refinance|purchase_rehab), occupancy (investment|owner), owner (entity|individual), propertyType (1-4|5-20|mixed), experience (0|1-2|3-5|6+), exit (sell|dscr|unsure), optional purchasePrice, rehabBudget, afterRepairValue. BC answers: timeInBusiness (<1|1-2|2-5|5+), nsf (0|1-3|4+), openPositions (no|yes), use (inventory|equipment|payroll|expansion|refinance|other), optional monthlyDeposits, amount.
